name: Sulong
description: The Minks' moon form: it needs a full moon and a Willpower that holds.

stages.name: Surviving the moon rite
stages.description: Look at the full moon and come back.
stages.text: You looked at the full moon and changed, and came back.

stages.name: Holding the form
stages.description: Hold the moon form and keep your mind.
stages.text: You held the moon form and kept your mind.

stages.name: Longer forms
stages.description: Longer in the form, and fewer after-effects.
stages.text: The moon form left you tired, not broken.
